subject: Brightly: incentive pathway and burn / target $ per 1M tokens
messages:
From: Alya Hassan <alya@brightly.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@brightly.ai
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up from today's demo — pricing & commitment questions

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the call today — the demo was helpful and the team is excited about the latency and cost profile you showed. A couple of follow-ups from our side as we prepare an internal budget ask:  

- Estimated monthly token burn: 25M tokens (chat + embeddings mix; peak 50k requests/day)
- Target budget range for the next 6–12 months: $15k–$40k / month (we're flexible if committed pricing improves unit economics)
- Program interest: Brightly is an early-stage startup (Series A) and would like to understand startup program credits and what committed-use discounts look like (6–12 month, 1- or 2-year options).

Could you send a concise proposal with a target $/1M tokens at a few commitment levels, and confirm any eligibility for the startup program? Also, if there are any operational limits (concurrency, max seq length considerations) that would affect cost, please flag them.

Appreciate it — I can loop in our finance lead if you want to discuss the exact bands.

Best,
Alya
Head of Product, Brightly

[Attachment: Brightly-architecture-overview.pdf (pdf)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alya Hassan <alya@brightly.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's demo — pricing & commitment questions

Alya — thanks for the clear notes and for sharing the burn estimate. Quick recap and next steps from our side so your finance team has what they need:  

Recap of Brightly numbers you shared:
• Baseline avg monthly: ~25M tokens (chat+embeddings).
• Short-term peak: could hit 50M tokens in high-traffic events.
• Budget target (6–12mo): $15k–$40k / mo.

Pricing / discount options (high level):
1) Self-serve / Hosted standard — pay-as-you-go: baseline $1,200 / 1M tokens for chat-workload equivalent (no commit). Helps for flexible usage but doesn't meet your budget target.
2) Startup program — one-time credit + 20–30% off the standard rate for qualified Series A teams; separate approval required (we'll need cap table or investor intro).
3) Committed-use (6–12mo) — typical bands: 10–25% off at small commits (~3–6M tokens/mo committed), 25–45% for larger commits (25M+/mo).
4) Multi-year / annual commit — deeper discounts and rebates (can approach your target $/1M if we combine a 2yr commit + performance-based rebate).

Based on your stated budget target, a viable structure to hit ~$400–700 / 1M tokens (your stated goal) would be:  
• 12-month committed contract at 25M tokens/mo with a blended discount ~40% + startup credit — effective rate ~ $550 / 1M tokens.

What I need from you to make a concrete proposal:  
- Confirmation of realistic committed floor (e.g., can Brightly commit to 15M, 25M, or 40M tokens / mo?).
- Preferred term (6, 12, 24 months).
- Any procurement constraints (PO, vendor form timeline).

I'll draft a 1-page term sheet and run a pricing model with Marissa (re: discounts/rebates) and Ben (legal/ops for startup credits). Expect a proposal by EOD Thursday if we lock the commit band today.

Cheers,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cell: +1 (415) 555-0189

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 10:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Brightly pricing / internal pricing check

Karthik — quick internal calc to validate margin at different commit bands before we send the term sheet:  

Assumptions: base cost equivalent (infra + support) ~ $200 / 1M tokens for blended chat/embedding workload at scale.

Scenarios (monthly committed tokens / effective $/1M):
- 15M commit: 30% discount -> $840 / 1M -> gross margin ~ 76% (ok)
- 25M commit: 40% discount -> $720 / 1M -> gross margin ~ 64% (still healthy)
- 40M commit: 45% discount -> $660 / 1M -> gross margin ~ 56% (acceptable with multi-year)

Startup credit: we can front-load a $15k credit + eligibility for the 20% program discount if investor intro or incorporation docs provided. Credit can be used against first two invoices.

Recommended path to propose externally:  
1) Primary offer: 12mo @ 25M/month commit, blended $720 / 1M + $15k startup credit applied across first invoices.
2) Alternate (stretch): 24mo @ 40M/month commit, blended $660 / 1M + performance rebate tied to growth bands.

Ben — please confirm legal Ops turnaround for a 12mo committed SOW with the startup credit clause (we may need a short investor attestation).

—Marissa
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alya Hassan <alya@brightly.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, procurement@brightly.ai
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's demo — pricing & commitment questions

Alya — attaching the short term sheet and pricing options (spreadsheet + one-pager). Quick summary and next steps:  

What we propose:  
• Option A (recommended): 12-month committed plan at 25M tokens/month -> effective $720 / 1M tokens after startup credit applied. Includes 1 free onboarding review and dedicated support during first 90 days.
• Option B (stretch): 24-month committed plan at 40M tokens/month -> effective $660 / 1M tokens + quarterly growth rebate if you exceed +10% growth bands.
• Startup program: $15k one-time credit + 20% program discount (requires short investor attestation). Credit applied to month 1–3 invoices.

Requested from Brightly to finalize proposal:  
1) Which option you prefer (A or B) and committed floor (15/25/40M).
2) Confirmation on procurement timeline and whether you require a PO before signature.
3) Investor attestation or incorporation docs to unlock the startup program.

Next steps: if you confirm Option A and provide the attestation, we can deliver an executable SOW and a payment schedule within 48 business hours. Attached: Brightly_MA_plan.xlsx, redwood-pricing-options.pdf

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min call to walk finance through the numbers.

Best,
Karthik
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
